[← All research areas](research.qmd)

MIMO systems use multiple antennas to transmit and receive signals. We study signal processing and spatial user separation in multi-user wireless systems.

We compare transmission and reception methods and evaluate the effects of the radio channel and inter-user interference. This work contributes to physical-layer research for 5G and 6G communication.
